name: Malou
oneLiner: Paris-based AI marketing platform for restaurant groups that combines review management, local SEO and listings, social media and visibility in AI search, available self-serve (MalouApp) or with a dedicated marketing expert (Copilot).
bestFor: Restaurant groups with three or more locations that want review replies, local SEO and social handled in one restaurant-specific platform, optionally with hands-on expert support.
features: AI review replies adapted to tone and sentiment, built from the brand's own voice guidelines
Reply quality score with tips based on Google's best practices
Alerts for sensitive review topics such as hygiene or discrimination
Semantic review analysis that surfaces recurring themes
Local SEO and listings management across Google and other platforms
Store locator and local pages optimized for search and AI search
Social media content creation and scheduling
Multi-location dashboard, in English, French, Italian and Spanish
Presence management across Google and 5 key local platforms (Essential) or 50+ platforms (Growth and Full)
Menu sync and publishing on Google (Full plan)

pricing.text: Custom pricing; Malou does not publish prices. Three plans (Essential, Growth, Full) priced by the number of locations you manage (bands of 1-2, 3-14, 15-99 and 100+); new locations are prorated for the rest of the billing period. Store Locator and Boosters are add-ons. Get a quote from sales.

notes: No dated 2025-2026 product update could be confirmed. A tendancehotellerie.fr page dated July 2026 headlines a EUR 10M raise for US expansion, but its text and all other coverage point to the November 2023 Series A (henQ, Bleu Capital), so it is not listed as an update. A co-founder's LinkedIn post about a 'Malou MCP' was undated and unconfirmed. Malou's blog quotes MalouApp at about $500-$3k/month; this is not an official pricing page, so not used. Customer counts (2,000 restaurants vs '3,500+ hospitality groups') and results (+160% organic traffic) are vendor claims, not used. Tin Building and Bagatelle were mentioned as clients in one summary but no source could be confirmed, so left out. WebFetch blocked; facts from search results. Pricing page opened November 2026: plan names and inclusions, no prices. G2 has one MalouApp review (G2 says there aren't enough reviews to give buying insight), so no rating is cited.
pros: Built only for restaurants: review replies, local SEO, listings and social in one tool
Choice of self-serve (MalouApp) or a dedicated marketing expert (Copilot) who handles SEO strategy, social content and monthly recommendations
Reply quality score and alerts for sensitive review topics such as hygiene or discrimination
Semantic analysis of recurring review themes
Works in English, French, Italian and Spanish

cons.text: No published prices; plans are quoted by the number of locations
Social media management and Google menu sync are only in the top plan (Full)
Store Locator and Boosters are sold as add-ons
Little independent feedback: MalouApp has a single review on G2, too few for G2 to rate it
Built for restaurants, so a brand that also runs other kinds of locations would need a second tool for those

plans.billing: custom quote based on the number of locations (bands of 1-2, 3-14, 15-99 and 100+)
